bias.en: Bearish · reclaimed the April lows, under the 5-day
bias.zh: 偏空 · 收复 4 月低点，仍在 5 日均线下方

read.en: Applied Materials rose 2.7% on Oct 26 to $387.59, trading between $378.20 and $393.18. It is below the falling 5-day ($390.9), 10-day ($411.8), 30-day ($462.4) and 100-day ($512.5) averages and the rising 200-day ($442.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($439.57), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: 应用材料 10月26日上涨 2.7%，收于 $387.59，盘中区间 $378.20–393.18。股价位于下行的 5 日（$390.9）、10 日（$411.8）、30 日（$462.4）和 100 日均线（$512.5）以及上行的 200 日均线（$442.5）下方。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$439.57），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The close cleared the $377–384 April-low zone (and the Oct 23 high), but the $393.2 high stalled at the 5-day average. Resistance is $390.9–393.2 (5-day, Oct 26 high), then $397–399 (May 19 and Oct 20 lows) and $407–414. Support is $377–384, then $372.8 (Oct 23 low) and $350. A close above $393.2 would target $397–408; a close below $372.8 would open $350.

s.en: Apr 15 and Apr 29 lows ($377.1–379.7), now support; Oct 26 low $378.2
